meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取 HEAD 与已发布 npm 版本之间的实际 diff,按三个发布层列出未发布的改动,并给出分层影响矩阵和每层的 patch/minor/major 版本建议。改动描述基于真实代码差异,不是照抄 commit 信息。
howto.when: 当你提到「unpublished changes」「changelog」「what changed」等关键词时触发;它会直接开始分析,不提问、不做开场白。

say.text: 列一下还没发布的改动
say.note: 按发布层输出改动清单

say.text: 给 oh-my-opencode 推荐个版本号
say.note: 输出分层和整体版本建议

say.text: 这些改动会影响哪些发布层?

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads the actual diff between HEAD and the latest published npm versions, lists unpublished changes by release layer, and outputs a layered impact matrix plus a patch/minor/major recommendation per layer. Descriptions come from real diffs, not copied commit messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "unpublished changes", "changelog", "what changed", etc. It starts the analysis immediately, with no questions or preamble.

say_en.text: List the changes that aren't published yet
Recommend a version bump for oh-my-opencode
Which release layers do these changes affect?
